liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Features a Slipknot tease in the middle of the performance; The jam is long and sweet, with two monstrous Slipknot teases [17][18]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Listener calls this the best version of the song they have ever heard [11]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Jerry misses high notes during this performance [22]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): The performance of this song is described as rocking [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-02-22.114556.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 38 songs; 251 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1974-02-22.151721.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 38 songs; 251 min [2]
- **gd74-02-22.sbd.patched.sirmick.21539.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 202 min; rated 4.16/5 by 37 [3]. Said about its sound: Vocals are poorly recorded in the second set, affecting the overall judgment [15]
- **gd1974-02-22.sbd.gans-latvala.samaritano.26763.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 208 min; rated 3.73/5 by 11 [4]
- **gd1974-02-22.176224.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 30 songs; 206 min [5]
- **gd74-02-22.sbd.unknown.11654.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 182 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: The soundboard mix is described as low on vocals, which is frustrating; The mix is a little muddy, though the show is a behemoth [12][17]

## Around the show

- The atmosphere is intimate, like being invited to the band's living room [13]
- This was the first show of the year, marking a fresh start [14]
- The Winterland run is described as totally electric and a turning point [19]
- A soundcheck was reported before this show, which may also circulate [1]
- Compared to other 1974 shows, this seems like an afterthought, though it is a good opener [15]
- Not considered the best of the three nights at Winterland, but very solid [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-02-22.114556.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]
- **gd1974-02-22.151721.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 13, 2021; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat [2]. Also: This is a fixed version of shnid=114556, with channels reversed; Some reels did not track properly on payback due to azimuth issues [2]
- **gd74-02-22.sbd.patched.sirmick.21539.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by SirMick; source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1974-02-22.sbd.gans-latvala.samaritano.26763.shnf**: transferred by See info file; source: Main Lineage: Soundboard->Vault Master Reel->DAT 48k, transferred 1991 Gans, 1st 45 minutes (US Blues->Big River); Soundboard->Master Reel->Cassette->DAT… [4]. Also: Transfer and editing by Joe Samaritano; patch source by Charlie Miller [4]
- **gd1974-02-22.176224.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [5]
- **gd74-02-22.sbd.unknown.11654.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
